name: 27_stack_building_bricks
title: Stacking and Sorting Toy Blocks
summary: A robotic arm stacks building blocks on a workbench, covers a block with another, and later reveals and stacks it.
robot: one white arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a robotics lab with a wooden workbench and colorful toy blocks

source.original_prompt: Stack green blocks on a blue base

segments.instruction: Pick up the green block from the table and align it over the blue base block.
Press the green block onto the blue base block to complete the stack, then release it.
Grasp the yellow block and place it upside-down over the loose green block to cover it.
segments.memory_event: hide: green block covered beneath the hollow yellow block

segments.instruction: Pick up the long red block and set it down to the left of the workspace.
Pick up the loose blue block and place it on top of the red block.
Lift the cover block and set it aside on the table.
segments.memory_event: return: green block uncovered, resting undisturbed on the table surface

segments.instruction: Pick up the uncovered block and place it atop the blue block on the left.
Release the block and raise the gripper into a parked position above the table.
